name: WordPress
guide: In WordPress, open Users → Profile → Application Passwords. Create a dedicated password and use your WordPress username. Your normal login password may not work.

name: Ghost
guide: In Ghost Admin, open Settings → Advanced → Integrations → Add custom integration. Use its Admin API key, not the Content API key. Ghost's admin domain can differ from your public website.

name: Shopify Blogs
guide: Install an app with read_content and write_content. For a store in your own Shopify organization, provide the app client ID and secret. Other stores need merchant OAuth installation or an existing Admin access token.

name: Webflow CMS
guide: In Webflow Site settings → Apps & integrations → API access, create a token with CMS read and write. Choose the collection and confirm which field holds article content.

name: Blogger / Blogspot
guide: Connect your Google account using the Blogger publishing scope. The workspace owner must first configure a Google OAuth web application and its callback URL in the backend.

name: Wix
guide: Use an API key from the site's owner or co-owner, with Manage Blog permission. Supply the Wix site ID and the author member ID. Your Wix account password cannot authorize its publishing API.

name: Drupal
guide: Your site administrator must enable JSON:API writes and HTTP Basic Authentication. The account needs create, edit and publish permission for the selected content type and text format.

name: Joomla
guide: Enable Joomla Web Services, Content API and API token plugins. Use a token for an account with API login and create/edit-state permissions. Choose an existing article category.

name: Custom website
guide: Configure an authorized API connector or a permitted browser editorial workflow. The connection report identifies the missing capability.

name: Connector setup required
guide: Configure an authorized API connector or a permitted browser editorial workflow. The connection report identifies the missing capability.
